headline: DeepSeek hits 13.4% — new all-time high
summary: DeepSeek's v4.1-flash just claimed the single largest token share ever recorded on OpenRouter at 13.4%, vaulting the provider to 27.6% combined dominance. The top three (DeepSeek, Zhipu AI, Tencent) now control 56.0% of the market. Meanwhile, OpenAI dropped 3.0% in a single day, and stealth's union-alpha vanished from the top 10.
